url_len.phishing: Elevated URL character length relative to baseline.
url_len.legitimate: Standard URL character length relative to baseline.

num_subdomains.legitimate: Low subdomain depth consistent with standard domain structure.

has_ip.phishing: Hostname uses raw numeric IP address format instead of a domain name.
has_ip.legitimate: Hostname uses standard domain name formatting.

count_at.phishing: Presence of '@' symbol in URL string.

count_dash.phishing: Elevated hyphen count in URL string.
count_dash.legitimate: Low hyphen count in URL string.

count_double_slash.phishing: Presence of additional '//' sequence in URL path.
count_double_slash.legitimate: No additional '//' sequence in URL path.

domain_entropy.phishing: Elevated domain character entropy relative to baseline.
domain_entropy.legitimate: Standard domain character entropy relative to baseline.

has_suspicious_params.phishing: Query string contains targeted authentication-related parameter keywords.
has_suspicious_params.legitimate: No targeted authentication keywords in query parameters.

brand_in_domain.phishing: Recognized brand keyword present in domain name.
brand_in_domain.legitimate: No recognized brand keyword match in domain name.

brand_in_subdomain.phishing: Recognized brand keyword present in subdomain prefix.
brand_in_subdomain.legitimate: No recognized brand keyword match in subdomain prefix.

has_typosquat.phishing: Domain contains edit-distance match to a recognized brand name.
has_typosquat.legitimate: Domain spelling does not match known brand edit-distance patterns.

has_punycode.phishing: Internationalized domain name encoding ('xn--' Punycode) in use.
has_punycode.legitimate: Standard ASCII character encoding in domain name.

excessive_subdomains.legitimate: Subdomain depth is 3 levels or fewer.

is_suspicious_tld.phishing: Top-Level Domain (TLD) matches list of higher-risk extensions.
is_suspicious_tld.legitimate: Top-Level Domain (TLD) is not in the higher-risk list.

free_hosting.phishing: Domain hosted on a recognized free or shared web hosting domain.
free_hosting.legitimate: Domain not hosted on known free or shared web hosting domains.

is_shortener.phishing: URL uses a recognized link shortening service.
is_shortener.legitimate: URL does not use a known link shortening service.

has_nonstandard_port.phishing: Non-standard network port specified in URL.

high_entropy.phishing: Domain character entropy exceeds the 3.5 threshold.
high_entropy.legitimate: Domain character entropy does not exceed the 3.5 threshold.

long_url.legitimate: URL length is 75 characters or fewer.

num_forms.phishing: Form element count relative to baseline.
num_forms.legitimate: Form element count consistent with baseline.

num_inputs.phishing: Input field count relative to baseline.
num_inputs.legitimate: Input field count consistent with baseline.

num_iframes.phishing: Presence of embedded iframe elements in page markup.
num_iframes.legitimate: Zero or expected iframe element count in page markup.

num_ext_links.phishing: External domain hyperlink count relative to baseline.
num_ext_links.legitimate: External domain hyperlink count consistent with baseline.

num_ext_scripts.phishing: External script source count relative to baseline.
num_ext_scripts.legitimate: External script source count consistent with baseline.

has_password_field.phishing: Password input field present in DOM.
has_password_field.legitimate: No password input field present in DOM.

has_meta_redirect.phishing: Meta-refresh tag present in DOM header.
has_meta_redirect.legitimate: No meta-refresh tag present in DOM header.

favicon_mismatch.phishing: Favicon loaded from external domain differing from page host.
favicon_mismatch.legitimate: Favicon loaded from same origin as page host.

has_auto_submit.phishing: Automated form submit script pattern detected in DOM.
has_auto_submit.legitimate: No automated form submit script pattern detected in DOM.

input_submit_ratio.phishing: Input-to-submit button ratio relative to baseline.
input_submit_ratio.legitimate: Input-to-submit button ratio consistent with baseline.

num_unique_ext_domains.phishing: Unique external domain reference count relative to baseline.
num_unique_ext_domains.legitimate: Unique external domain reference count consistent with baseline.
